name: tests-half-go-workflows-durable-backend-namespaces
instr:
go-workflows cannot isolate independent workflow populations sharing a MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, or Redis store. Add durable namespace selection through the existing backend option convention, covering the complete workflow lifecycle and every operational view without changing unconfigured behavior.

`ParseNamespace` accepts nonempty ASCII values matching `[a-z0-9-]+`. `default` is reserved for `DefaultNamespace`; invalid input returns `InvalidNamespaceError` with the rejected value. `WithNamespace(namespace)` applies the selected `Namespace` to every supported backend constructor. It remains immutable and visible through `Options.Namespace` for the backend lifetime.

Scope every durable identity and operation by namespace in all four backends. Colliding workflow, execution, activity, and task identifiers must neither conflict nor cross-read. Duplicates within one namespace retain established conflict behavior. Apply the boundary to task acquisition and recovery, signals, cancellation, timers, activities, histories, removal, expiration, completion, continued-as-new lineage, and every atomic or transactional operation.

Redis must compose namespace identity with `KeyPrefix` across keys and workflow and activity queues, without exposing or conflating the physical prefix. `GetStats` reports only the selected namespace through `Stats.Namespace`. Diagnostic listings, cursors, details, histories, and trees follow the same boundary and expose it through `WorkflowInstanceRef.Namespa
